description:
Functional specifications covered / files: lib/zaq/agent/tools/data_source/attach_documents.ex, tools/registry.ex, stream_events.ex, executor.ex, opaque_aliases.ex; tools/workflow/run_agent.ex, tools/people/notify_person.ex; engine/notifications.ex
Port AttachDocuments as the missing explicit selection Action; reuse GetDocument/Record authorization and add/remove/replace reducer. Return failures in tool feedback/logging only; accumulate successful selection request-locally. Rewrite old tool instructions claiming selection failures block Channel sends. Carry only attachment Records through pipeline, RunAgent and NotifyPerson/Notifications. Empty selected list is normal text. Preserve failed/cancelled request cleanup and existing workflow lifecycle.

Tests to add before implementation: Selection ordering/dedup properties; add/remove/replace; partial selection failure and successful retry do not poison outgoing; unauthorized/stale Records; request isolation/cancellation; Agent-to-Channel, workflow and notification journeys.

Branches/paths validated: Selection ordering/dedup properties; add/remove/replace; partial selection failure and successful retry do not poison outgoing; unauthorized/stale Records; request isolation/cancellation; Agent-to-Channel, workflow and notification journeys.

Action reuse assessment: New-to-this-branch Action port of existing AttachDocuments, not duplicate DownloadDocument (materializes rather than selects). Reuse GetDocument, Record Authorization/Provenance, validated Jido/StepRunner execution; trusted event context and existing APIs. Action introduction and consumers are sequenced inside this task; split further if implementation requires independent changes.

Consumers/execution: preserve existing Agent/Engine/Channel service boundaries; plan and prepared content never cross to Engine. Tool selection has no delivery side effect. Transport failures are reported without automatic retries.

Planning only in feat/delivery_plan; do not implement until the proposed migration is reviewed. Policies: AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md; relevant service guides before affected work. Existing test behavior changes require specific approval; none granted by this plan. Mocking plan: keep internal boundaries real; isolate external transport/LLM APIs and inject runtime config without global mutations. Documentation: update module contracts and relevant owning service guide with implemented behavior, not duplicate policies. Validation follows authoritative workflow timing.

comments.text: Scope refinement: this issue introduces and tests the AttachDocuments Action, registry/alias schema integration and pure selection reducer only. Producer accumulation and propagation are owned by zaq-6rc.10. Existing producer references in the description are downstream acceptance context, not implementation in this issue. Preserve authorization and tool feedback; remove instructions about selection errors poisoning Channel delivery.

title: [zaq-6rc.8] Port AttachDocuments selection Action
